ADVISORY: Weather Update and Dress-Down Recommendation — Metro Manila

Good day, ABC team.

As of Wednesday, September 2, 2026, Metro Manila is experiencing light drizzle. Current conditions are 28°C (feels like 29.7°C), with 80% humidity. Winds are approximately 31.1 km/h, with gusts up to 73.8 km/h. Today’s forecast calls for unsettled weather, around 11.6 mm of rain, gusts up to 78.8 km/h, and temperatures from 26.5°C to 30.3°C.

No verified PAGASA advisory was available from this automated check.

Given these adverse weather conditions, employees should allow extra travel time and prioritize safety while commuting. Employees who need to report on-site may dress down in casual, comfortable, and weather-appropriate attire.

Stay safe and coordinate with your immediate supervisor regarding your schedule. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
